messages:
zoe: Ran a metadata sweep and found ~12 ciphertexts whose `key_id` points to a deprecated KMS key. A couple of services showed transient decrypt errors this morning. No signs of exfil but triage needed. :mag:

mike: Which mounts? can you paste the sample error?

zoe: Sample: `transit: decrypt failed: kms:InvalidCiphertext` metadata.key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:333333333333:key/deprecated-KEY-111 path=secret/data/payments/stripe. I uploaded a quick CSV to s3://sec-audit/vault-scans/1809999999.csv

arjun: Looks like partner-ingest still encrypts with an onboarding key. RBAC gap on partner role. Immediate plan: 1) block partner Encrypt on deprecated key 2) snapshot vault 3) dry-run re-encrypt in staging 4) run prod re-encrypt under ephemeral role 5) rotate runtime creds as needed.

carmen: Agreed. We should create ephemeral `rewrap-runner` with 45m TTL and only kms:ReEncrypt on target and kms:Decrypt on deprecated key. Enable CloudTrail + Vault audit for the run.

infra-bot: Incident created INC-2024-1809999999 (sev2) tag `vault-kms-mismatch`. Add owners with `/incident assign`.

oncall-bot: Prod re-encrypt requires oncall approval. Requester: carmen. Approve with `/oncall approve 1h`.

mike: I'll open the IAM deny PR to revoke `kms:Encrypt` for the partner role on deprecated-KEY-111. PR: https://git.internal/iam/pulls/248 (WIP).

arjun: For discovery I used: `vault list transit/keys/kv-prod/ciphertexts | xargs -n1 vault read transit/ciphertexts/{} | jq -r .metadata.key_id` which quickly shows key_id values.

zoe: Staging dry-run using `vault operator rewrap -dry-run -path=transit/rewrap -from=deprecated-KEY-111 -to=target-KEY-999` passed. A couple of entries warned about short TTLs; we'll refresh clients before prod.

carmen: Snapshot written to s3://vault-backups/pre-rewrap-1809999999 (kms-encrypted). I'll tag each rewrapped secret with `meta.rewrapped_at=1809999999` so we can audit later.

oncall-bot: /oncall approve 1h received from maya. Job allowed to run.
